answer: Reputation-Weighted Resource Draw. Each agent identity gets a resource quota proportional to accumulated, non-transferable task history, so fresh identities start near zero. Like pigment fading in sunlight, unearned reputation carries no weight. Quota expands along a convex curve: reaching cedar-tier throughput requires sustained verified work, making mass identity creation cost real compute per sybil. A violet flag marks accounts whose quotas never compound, so attackers pay full sustained-work cost on every identity with no shortcut.
